column3: MT 34:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. The Hebrew title is “Of David”; NASB adds “A Psalm” and sets the title in braces, but this copy closes the brace early and puts “away and he departed” in parentheses. “Changed his sense” is rendered “feigned madness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “let them hear” is rendered “shall hear.”
Close to the Hebrew; “may they not be abashed” is rendered “shall never be ashamed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “His holy ones” is rendered “His saints.”
Close to the Hebrew; “days” is rendered “length of days.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “open.”
The Hebrew does not name the subject of “they cry”; NASB supplies “The righteous.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will be held guilty” is rendered “will be condemned.”
